sources.access_limitations: instagram.com HTML is not scraped (login wall / access control); posts come from manual_import collection, basic data only, metrics are a snapshot

provenance.collected_by: Claude Code operator session (development time) - NOT the studio runtime agent
provenance.method: Apify actor apify/instagram-post-scraper via the Apify MCP connector; dataDetailLevel=basicData
provenance.source_description: Public posts of https://www.instagram.com/gymbeamhr/ (feed order, newest first)
provenance.selection: The 30 newest posts whose ownerUsername is gymbeamhr. The run returned 60 items (46 brand-owned, 14 owned by other accounts = creator collaborations, excluded). 16 older brand-owned posts were returned but not imported.
provenance.captions: Copied programmatically from the raw export; media (images/video) NOT stored in the repo.
provenance.metrics_note: likes/comments are a snapshot at collected_at; hidden counts (-1) are null.
provenance.estimated_cost_usd: about 0.10 (60 posts x 0.0017 listed FREE-tier price; actual Apify billing not checked)
provenance.supersedes: earlier 10-post import from runs IBw4JCdf06bKLQwA7 / aTPUrqbrkIqnXC8o3
